Description
Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Nestled on one of Kitsilano's most picturesque and sought-after streets, this exceptional two-level townhome is located just one block from the beach on charming York Avenue, surrounded by cherry blossom trees and beautiful executive residences. Offering approximately 1,499 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home features 2 bedrooms, a den, 2 bathrooms, and stunning views of the water, mountains, and city skyline. The main level offers an inviting open-concept kitchen, a spacious dining area ideal for entertaining, a private deck, and a well-appointed bedroom and full bathroom. A private rooftop deck provides the perfect setting to relax. One covered carport parking space included. If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent. **Unfurnished is not an option**

Description
Situated on a sun-drenched, south-facing corner lot in Kitsilano, this 1,700 sq. ft. Craftsman character home blends 1920s architecture with contemporary luxury and North Shore mountain views. The open-concept 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom layout features rich wood flooring, refined millwork, and a chef’s kitchen equipped with premium Wolf gas appliances and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Step outside to a private, sunny yard and patio. Unbeatable Westside location: steps to General Gordon Elementary, Kitsilano Secondary, and the Kitsilano Bike Path for an easy ride to UBC or Downtown. Enjoy West 4th Avenue’s boutique shops, cafes, and dining, with Kits Beach and its saltwater pool just a short stroll away. If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent.
